headline: Outlets split on whether Ukraine's Yandex strikes actually curbed Russian bots
summary: Ukrainian drone strikes knocked out several Yandex data centers, disrupting cloud services and payments. One outlet reported Russian bot traffic nearly eliminated as a result, but another found the outage probably didn't reduce the bot activity associated with Russia, and reported Russian bot farms still trolling days later despite a presidential claim that the strikes hurt disinformation efforts.
